questions.q: What does Elrod say about reacting to cancer?
questions.why: Elrod stresses not to be upset over things beyond control.

questions.q: Which lesson warns against overloading goals?
questions.why: The text advises focusing on one primary goal to avoid overwhelm.

questions.q: What is described as more powerful than emotions?
questions.why: Peace is cited as more powerful than fleeting emotions.

questions.q: Elrod's recovery after a 6‑minute death pronouncement illustrates what?
questions.why: His story shows extraordinary effort and unwavering faith.

questions.q: Which lesson suggests using existing knowledge for results?
questions.why: The book says we often know what to do but lack a method to implement it.
